title: Try this 3-step reset for your next idea
description: An original Beyond Orbit text-only experiment. Pick one small next step. Silent video with on-screen captions. No third-party footage or music.
scenes: Too many ideas? Try this 3-step reset.
Step 1: Write down one thing you want to make.
Step 2: Choose the smallest version you can finish.
A whole channel can wait. Start with one useful video.
Step 3: Make it, review it, and learn from the result.
What is the smallest next step you can take today?
